Rooms.Name: On the Outskirts of the Hobbit Habitation
Rooms.Description:
A broad path neatly bordered with short, well-trimmed bushes runs
north and south from here.  To the east and west of you, fields of
sweetly scented tobacco remind you of the little hobbit village to the
south.

Exits.Description: The broad path stretches endlessly north and up from here.

Just up ahead you can see a well.  Just the thing for filling your
canteen.

Rooms.Name: Achoo!
Rooms.Description:
Surrounded by tobacco, you may have a faint memory of the Tobacco
Wars some years past, when the Hobbits refused to sell to the dwarves at
their usual price.  Reason?  The dwarves were trying to trade low
quality steel plows and hoes for their farming.  The road continues
north for a spell then turns east around a tobacco field.  To the south
you can see the outskirts of the hobbit habitat.

Exits.Description: The path continues, winding around tobacco fields.
To the south you can see the outskirts of the hobbit habitat.

Rooms.Name: Around the Tobacco Field
Rooms.Description:
The hobbit road twists west and north here, making its way around a
field of tobacco south to the village and north towards some big Purple
Mountains, the dwarven mining kingdom if rumor is to be believed.

Exits.Description: Far off in the distance you can make out what looks like a small well.

The path west wraps around a field of tobacco and continues in the same
direction the sun travels.

Rooms.Name: Fertile Farmland
Rooms.Description:
All around you lie fertile, well cultivated fields.  To the south you
can see endless stretches of tall, broad-leaved tobacco plants, growing
a rich dark green.  To the north of this east-west track, densely
planted rows of corn block your path.  The silken tassels on their ears
wave slightly in the light breeze.

Exits.Description:
Up ahead the path takes a sharp turn around the corner of a tobacco
field.
Up ahead, the path takes a sharp turn around the corner of a corn field.

Rooms.Name: Corn and Green Fields
Rooms.Description:
Surrounded by green fields and the occasional crow, it is amazing how
quiet it is here in the country.  You are in a very large flat valley.
To the north you can see gently rolling foothills leading slowly to
steep mountains.  South, east and west of you lie flat, fertile valley
rimmed by mountains so far away they seem unreal.  The path extends
north and east from here.
#G  A large sign stands in front of the cornfield to the west.#N

Exits.Description: The path northwards gradually begins to rise and fall.
Past tobacco patch and cornfield, the broad cart track heads east.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The sign has no words, just a big picture of a corn stalk with a red
circle around it and a line running diagonally from one side of the
circle to the other.

Rooms.Name: Fertile Farm Fields
Rooms.Description:
A path broad enough for a heavy cart leads north and south from here
in between well tended fields.  Widely scattered farmhouses dot the
fertile valley.  In one field, an old plough has been left to rust,
while in another, at some distance to the north, you see a farmer at
work.

Exits.Description: The path rolls on through fertile farmland.
The path rolls on through fertile farmland.

Rooms.Name: Fields of Corn
Rooms.Description:
The densely planted rows of corn generally keep you to the broad cart
track, however a small path separating two fields of corn leads
westwards from here.  The cart track runs north and south in apparently
endlessly rolling fields of flawlessly fertile farmland.
#G  A small bright yellow sign shows a big red hand pointing west.#N

Exits.Description: The cart track leads off over rolling hills northwards.
Fertile fields surround you.
A very narrow path leads between two fields of corn.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Well worn lettering on the sign reads,
 
#g   Gnomish Pscientific Agricultural Research Center.
#y              Hands off the corn!!!

Rooms.Name: The Kennel
Rooms.Description:
In a small clearing in the middle of the densely planted corn, you
can see a small wooden one room house.  From the prints in the dirt
around the house you can see that at least one dog lives here.  Since it
seems an odd thing to guard, you might surmise that either there is an
unusual threat (to corn) nearby or this is very special (and unusual)
corn.  A very narrow path runs east and west from here.

Exits.Description: The narrow path intersects with a wider cart track to the east.

The path is too narrow for you to see much, but you might catch a
glimpse of a small farmhouse.

Rooms.Name: The Pscientific Agricultural Research Center (PARC)
Rooms.Description:
A small cluster of buildings lies at the end of a short narrow path
through densely planted fields of corn.  At the center of the cluster is
a large building topped with a glowing, translucent dome.  Gnomes
dressed in white lab coats are scurrying hither and thither.  You can
head for the hills (east), the dome (west) or one of the small
outbuildings (north and south).

Exits.Description: An anonymous, whitewashed building lies north.
The path will take you back through the corn field.
One of the many small whitewashed buildings lies south.
The Dome!

Rooms.Name: Inside the GnomeDome
Rooms.Description:
Brilliant sunlight surrounds you, streaming from an unseen source.
Long rows of dirt separated by narrow stone paths have been planted with
flowers, fruits and vegetables both mundane and arcane.  As the lab
gnomes walk the rows, flowers blossom brightly and vines stretch out
towards them as if looking for an affectionate touch.

Exits.Description: The enormous greenhouse extends to the north for some distance.

A thick glass door bearing a small "Remember to shut me, please" sign
marks the way out.

Rooms.Name: The Toolshed
Rooms.Description:
A small dark shack is filled with small, ordinary gardening
implements.  There are hoes, rakes, shovels, spades, buckets, leather
gardening gloves made to fit small gnomish hands, and other implements
you may not recognize.  All are made of finest dwarven steel.

Exits.Description: Through cracks in the old wooden door you can see the garden.

Rooms.Name: The Root Cellar
Rooms.Description:
Steps lead sharply down to cool earthy darkness.  You are surrounded
by thick glass jars preserving peaches, peas, pomegranates, powders,
potions, pigs feet, and other, less identifiable items.  Roots of all
sorts - feathery white tendrils and thick-as-a-trolls-arm-feelers - grow
through the earthen walls of the cellar, reaching towards the gnomish
preserves.

Rooms.Name: A Dividing Point
Rooms.Description:
The fields of corn abruptly disappear as you head northward through
the rolling hills.  To the south, thick fields of corn flank the path.
Further south you can see the broad green leaves of hobbit tobacco.

Exits.Description: Fallow fields fill your view to the north.
The gnomish farm research station lies just south of here.

Rooms.Name: On the Right Path
Rooms.Description:
The broad path here shows evidence of considerable travel.  In the
distance to the east you can see spiraling smoke and an oddly metallic
scent.  An occasional scream is quickly and quenched.  South of you the
path rolls into fertile fields and a large, flat valley.  To the north
loom the purple mountains of the Dwarves.

Rooms.Name: Onward and Upward (or Downward)
Rooms.Description:
A broad, well-traveled cart track leads northwards towards the base
of some spooky purple mountains.  To the south the path flattens and
gradually smooths.  To the west and east, the land gradually rises and
the valley ends with a wall of mountains.

Rooms.Name: Sloping through the Hills
Rooms.Description:
A broad dirt path rolls along north and south through gentle fertile
foothills and the northern end of a huge valley.  The hills are covered
with deep velvet green grasses, too thick to push your way through.

Exits.Description: Roll up north towards the nearby mountains.
Roll south towards the flatter valley.

Rooms.Name: A Deeply-Rutted Cart Track
Rooms.Description:
A narrow dirt track runs east and west through verdant fields of
grass towards a field thick with tall vines to the west, and a narrow
path through the farmland to the east.

Exits.Description: There appears to be a fork in the track to the east.
The track continues through a field of hops.

Rooms.Name: A Field of Hops
Rooms.Description:
Tall vines fill the fields to the right and left of you.  You may
recognize the vines as hops.  The vines appear to be quite healthy and
thick, crowding the edge of the path and extending for as far as you can
see north and south.  The track continues both east and west from here.

Exits.Description: The cart track continues east through green fields lying fallow.
The ground slowly rises eastwards towards a small plateau.

Rooms.Name: Foothills
Rooms.Description:
From the slow rise of the cart track as it heads westwards you can
tell you have entered the foothills of the Dwarven Mountains.  The
fields around you appear well-tended, planted with hops, grains and
other crops that you don't recognize.  The track west continues to rise,
slowly descending into a fertile valley to the east.

Exits.Description:
Following the cart track west would be an easy, peaceful descent through
green and golden farmland.

As the cart track rises slowly towards a plateau, you see the crops
change, adapting to the cooler mountain air.

Rooms.Name: The Plateau
Rooms.Description:
By the neatly laid out, well tended fields around you, you realize
you have entered the heart of Gnomish farmland.  Mountain raspberries
and strawberries abound, the red berries and lush green leaves giving
the fields a Christmassy appearance.  West of here, across a few
fields, you see a small neat farmhouse with a big red barn.  To the
east, the cart track slowly descends through fertile farmlands.

Exits.Description:
Down a gradual slope, through lovely green and gold fields, the cart
track appears to run on endlessly.
Up ahead you can see a small farmhouse, a large barn and a HUGE fence.

Rooms.Name: The Gate
Rooms.Description:
A very tall gate bars the path west.  The gate is made of heavy
planks of wood, with a steel latch about a third of the way up.  The
gate is very large and must be very heavy, but the hinges at one side
appear to be high quality, well-oiled steel.

Exits.Description: A cart track leads through fields of raspberries and strawberries.

A very heavy, very solid gate was designed to keep you out of the farm
... or to keep the farmers in.  Which one?  It does not appear to lock.

Rooms.Name: The Gnome Home
Rooms.Description:
A small whitewashed house sits just south of the track, the door
covered with paintings of small hands in all colors and varying sizes.
Well washed windows flank the door, one on each side, and a small brick
chimney sitting atop the house pours woodsmoke into the sky.  Everything
is on a small scale, suited for a human child of perhaps 8.

Exits.Description:
A narrow cart track runs east and west.  To the east lies an enormous
gate and fields of berries.
The door to the house has a big brass knob.

The cart track continues for a short ways, ending in a very large barn,
painted a bright red.

Rooms.Name: Inside the Gnome Farmhouse (GnomeHome)
Rooms.Description:
A warm cheery fire (perfect for storytelling) burns in a huge red
brick fireplace.  In front of the fireplace, over the shiny wooden
floor, sits a thick braided rug.  In one corner, on some shelves firmly
attached to the wall, there are sets of carding combs and a large jar
labeled "yak fur shampoo".  Huge baskets of yak hair in all colors sit
around the room.

Exits.Description:
The entrance to this little house is the door in the north wall of the
house.

An open archway leads south to a kitchen.  Wonderful smells are coming
from that kitchen.

Rooms.Name: Cookie Kitchen
Rooms.Description:
The large warm kitchen is a favorite room for the gnomes.  Here they
cook up their wild experiments and their wildberry cookies.  There is an
oven large enough to cook a yak, a big sink for washing dishes, and a
small cool pantry to keep fresh produce.  To the north lies their living
room / storytelling room.  Rooms lie both east and west of here.

Exits.Description:
Through the open archway to the north you can see the gnomes' living
room and the door to the Great Outdoors.
A small door leads into another part of the house.
Strange smells and noises come from the door west.

Rooms.Name: Rows of Beds
Rooms.Description:
Rows of small beds line the walls in this room.  Unlike the others,
this room is painted a cool soft dark blue, the color of night.  Small
gnomes creep in here to sleep no matter what time of day.  The colors
help to calm their active imaginations enough for them to sleep.  Their
intense curiosity, constant wonder and industriousness often keep them
awake.

Exits.Description: The lovely smells of a kitchen float in from the west.

Rooms.Name: Gnome Playroom
Rooms.Description:
A large, open room, lined with glass-paned windows, this room is the
Official Gnomish Playroom / Thinktank.  Large comfortable chairs and a
long, low worktable fill the room.  Books on the arcane and unusual as
well as the ordinary ("Jorge's Book of Bad Jokes") line the walls.  A
few scorch marks and oddly colored stains show the results of
experiments that did not quite work out.

Exits.Description: A small door leads to the kitchen area of the house.

Rooms.Name: The Big Red Barn
Rooms.Description:
One of the biggest barns you have EVER seen sits at the western end
of the cart track.  Huge double doors stand wide open allowing you to
peer inside.  The front of the barn has been heavily decorated with
abstract but pleasing designs in bright colors.  The barn lies to the
west, the farmhouse to the east.

Exits.Description:
Down a deeply rutted cart track you can see a beautiful but smallish
white farmhouse.

You can easily walk through the open barn doors into the vast, dim
interior of the barn.

Rooms.Name: Inside the Big Red Yak Barn
Rooms.Description:
This vast space, dimly lit by windows high up under the overhanging
eaves of the barn, serves as winter housing and grain storage for the
small herd of yaks that provides part of the farm's livelihood.  The
yaks enjoy the adventure of travel up into the mountains, and they are
able to carry some of the heavier equipment needed on a long journey.
 
#GA large ring lies recessed in the ground.#N

Exits.Description: Large doors lead out to green pasture.
Large doors lead to a rutted cart track heading east.
Large doors lead out to green pasture.
Large doors lead out to green pasture.

A trap door conceals a large storage area used to hide the gnomes'
treasures from mountain bandits.  The ladder down has been removed,
however, so there is no way to safely descend.

Rooms.Name: Green Pastures Filled with Yaks
Rooms.Description:
Deep, lushly green pastures roll on for as far as you can see,
providing plenty of forage for the farm's small herd of yaks.  The yaks
always know their way home to the barn, though, when they want their
horns polished or their hair trimmed or combed.

Exits.Description: As far as you can see, the lush pasture continues.
As far as you can see, the lush pasture continues.
A big red barn looks back at you
As far as you can see, the lush pasture continues.

Rooms.Name: Green Pastures Filled with Yaks
Rooms.Description:
Deep, lushly green pastures roll on for as far as you can see,
providing plenty of forage for the farm's small herd of yaks.  The yaks
always know their way home to the barn, though, when they want their
horns polished or their hair trimmed or combed.

Exits.Description: A big red barn stares back at you.
As far as you can see, the lush pasture continues.
As far as you can see, the lush pasture continues.
As far as you can see, the lush pasture continues.

Rooms.Name: Green Pastures Filled with Yaks
Rooms.Description:
Deep, lushly green pastures roll on for as far as you can see,
providing plenty of forage for the farm's small herd of yaks.  The yaks
always know their way home to the barn, though, when they want their
horns polished or their hair trimmed or combed.

Exits.Description: As far as you can see, the lush pasture continues.
A big red barn sits squarely east of you.
As far as you can see, the lush pasture continues.
As far as you can see, the lush pasture continues.

Rooms.Name: Gnomish Treasure
Rooms.Description:
Your last thoughts as you fall into the pit filled with
upward-pointing yak horns had probably best be kept to yourself.

Exits.Description: If you are a REAL goddess, you'll just head right back up.

Rooms.Name: The GnomeDome
Rooms.Description:
For as far as the human eye can see, the magical dome over the
agricultural research station provides shelter from the weather and
privacy from curious eyes.  All around you, small, pointy eared gnomes
with charmingly ugly little faces tend flowers and plants of many odd
varieties.  There appears to be a door leading west.

Exits.Description: The magnificent greenhouse continues south of here.
A small wooden door leads west.

Rooms.Name: Sunflowers
Rooms.Description:
You need some sort of eye covering here, for the light is quite
bright and the heat intense.  Hundreds, maybe even thousands of shining
sunflower faces are turned in your direction, and seem to follow you
wherever you go.

Exits.Description:
A small (gnome-sized) wooden door painted white reflects the sunlight
back at you.

Fields of bright, hot sunflowers line both sides of this path.  Doesn't
look comfortable.

Rooms.Name: Sunflower Path
Rooms.Description:
Walking a long a narrow gap in a field of sunflowers, the heat and
light of the plants beats down upon you like an iron club fresh from the
forge.  The gnomes must all have green thumbs, for these sunflowers are
thriving here.

Exits.Description:
The narrow area between the two fields of sunflowers shines brightly in
their light.
The bright light of the sunflowers dims in the distance.

The narrow area between the two fields of sunflowers shines brightly in
their light.

Rooms.Name: Sunflower Path
Rooms.Description:
The radiant light from both huge fields of sunflowers leaves no place
of shade or shadow.  The sunflowers lift their dark faces to the sun,
bright yellow petals waving with pleasure.  The path between the fields
continues westward for a small distance, coming to a stop at a tall
fence.

Exits.Description: The bright faces of the sunflowers compete with the sun.
The bright fields of sunflowers stop abruptly by a tall fence.

Rooms.Name: Shade Trees
Rooms.Description:
Low, leafy trees spread long branches, inviting you to find shadows
and cool comfort beneath them.  Remnants of cookies and ham sandwiches
beneath some of the trees, and a long rope hanging from one of them hint
that you may have stumbled on a picnic spot.  The path south is blocked
by a stream.

Exits.Description: Bright fields of sunflowers warm you in their heat.
Just how strong are you?  The rope leads up ... up ... up ...

Rooms.Name: The Fence
Rooms.Description:
From north and south of you come the heat and light of a million
sunflowers.  It is always summer in the sunflower field, the cycle of
birth and death appears to have stopped here.  To the west is a very
very tall, white painted fence.  A knothole in the fence is just about
at the level of your eye.

Exits.Description:
Bright fields of sunshine extend for some distance, terminating in an
enormous structure made of some clear substance.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: You can see nothing but dark and cold with no sunshine.

Rooms.Name: Up a Swaying Rope
Rooms.Description:
The thick rope rises up and up and up to where it is tied to a sturdy
branch in what, to a gnome, is a very tall tree.  As you climb the rope
it gently swings to and fro over a narrow but apparently deep stream.
Are you about to get a dunking ?

Exits.Description: Leafy green branches reach for the sky and so does your rope.

The rope is swaying rapidly, and the ground beneath you is replaced by
water and again by ground in such rapid succession you may be sick to
your stomach.

Rooms.Name: Up a Swaying Rope
Rooms.Description:
The thick rope rises up and up and up to where it is tied to a sturdy
branch in what, to a gnome, is a very tall tree.  As you climb the rope
it gently swings to and fro over a narrow but apparently deep stream.
Are you about to get a dunking ?

Exits.Description: Leafy green branches reach for the sky and so does your rope.

The rope is swaying rapidly, and the ground beneath you is replaced by
water and again by ground in such rapid succession you may be sick to
your stomach.

Rooms.Name: Intense Vegetation
Rooms.Description:
A narrow, deep cold stream runs east to west here in a rather lazy
fashion.  It is just a bit too wide to jump over.  A long rope dangles
down from a tree overhead, and to the south, thick vines, thorny bushes
and intense vegetation appear to block your path.

Exits.Description: Intense vegetation and thick, thorny vines block the path south.
A thick rope dangles just over your head.

Rooms.Name: Following a road in the mountains
Rooms.Description:
The mountain road whindles as it leads you through the mountainous
terrain. Make sure you do not slip, a fall would be very disastrous.
There seems to be a slight opening in the mountains east of here,
perhaps it is a little valley. Why don't you have a look ?

Exits.Description: The mountain opens up.
A little road trails off.

Rooms.Name: A little field in the mountains
Rooms.Description:
You have reached a little field placed in the middle of the
mountains.  This looks like a place in harmony. No risk of avalanches.
The grass is green and even a few birds chirp happily in the
surrounding. There is nothing wrong with this picture except the
enormous chasm that opens up the mountain on the east side of the
field. Perhaps you should stay here where you are in guaranteed safety.

Exits.Description: A little house stands on the very verge of falling into the chasm.
A little road trails off.

Rooms.Name: A house at a chasm
Rooms.Description:
Standing directly on the very verge of falling into a huge chasm is a
little house. It looks a bit shabby but it still stands there. This is a
bit strange as two heavy ropes lead away from the house over the chasm
to the other side.

Exits.Description: A little clearing looks rather inviting.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
You now see how very large the chasm is. Very large. And there seems to
be a very strange wind blowing in the chasm. Even if you grew wings it
would not be possible to pass it in that manner. Just forget it.

It leads to another similar house on the other side of the chasm.
Perhaps those ropes can be used to take you over to the other side.

Rooms.Name: Standing in a basket inside a wooden house
Rooms.Description:
Ah, The house is a start on a ropeway over the chasm.
The powerful ropes that go over the chasm will, probably, take you over
safe. But you have to work for it. Incorporated in the bottom of the
basket you are standing in is a treadmill. Walk in the opposite
direction you came and the basket will take you over the chasm. Neat and
simple.  The door has closed behind you, so start walking.

Exits.Description: You are not going this way, especially if you try.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The basket is woven tightly together by the same kind of rope as the
rope that carries you. How the rope weaver was able to get the treadmill
into the floor is beyond your ability to comprehend.
Fascinating. Start walking or you will hang here forever...

Rooms.Name: Hanging in a basket over a chasm
Rooms.Description:
The basket is swaying considerably, mostly due to the fact that you
are or were walking around in it and only a little part due to the fact
that a terrible storm roars just a few feet away from you. It seems that
the basket is protected in some kind of safe pocket. You are still not
over so keep on walking or the wind just might get closer...

Exits.Description: Where you came from and where you are not going.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
There has got to be some kind of magic involved  in this, the wind
roars and your little carriage is almost totally unaffected. Perhaps
this is used as some kind of limitation to how many and what kind of
guests that should be allowed to pass over.

Hmmmmm...
It is deep, so very deep. But was not there something gleaming down
there?

Hmmmmm...

Darkness should not be gleaming. There is definitely something wrong
with this place. That depth need to be further investigated but where
can one descent safely. Not here for sure. Maybe a long ladder would
help...

Rooms.Description:
Ah, The house is a start on a ropeway over the chasm.
The powerful ropes that go over the chasm will, probably, take you over
safe. But you have to work for it. Incorporated in the bottom of the
basket you are standing in is a treadmill. Walk in the opposite
direction you came and the basket will take you over the chasm.
Neat and simple.  The door has closed behind you so you better
start walking.

Exits.Description: You are not going this way, especially if you try.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The basket is woven tightly together by the same kind of rope as the
rope that carries you. How the rope weaver was able to get the treadmill
into the floor is beyond your ability to comprehend.
Fascinating. Start walking or you will hang here forever...

Rooms.Name: Back in a house at the chasm edge
Rooms.Description:
The basket comes in inside a house again. Easy as it completely lacks
the walls towards the chasm. How does it manage to stand, mysterious.
Well now you have two options:   Either jump 'ashore' or start walking
on another trip. You have paid for unlimited travel as long as you
ticket lasts so why not take another spin?

Exits.Description: You have to walk this way to get out on the ropeway again.
A relative safety on the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
One gone - three to go. When will this shabby pile of rubble called
house fall down? The world is full of unanswered questions. You did not
even know that I was watching, did you ? ....   Mooaahaahaaaaaaaaaaa !!!

Rooms.Name: Back in a house at the chasm edge
Rooms.Description:
The basket comes in inside a house again. Easy as it completely lacks
the walls towards the chasm. How does it manage to stand, mysterious.
Well now you have two options either jump 'ashore' or start walking on
another trip. You have paid for unlimited travel as long as your ticket
lasts so why not take another spin.

Exits.Description: You have to walk this way to get out on the ropeway again.
Relative safety on the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
One gone - three to go. When will this shabby pile of rubble called
house fall down? The world is full of unanswered questions. You did not
even know that I was watching, did you ? ....   Mooaahaahaaaaaaaaaaa !!!

Rooms.Name: A house at a chasm
Rooms.Description:
You are standing next to a house on the very edge of a huge chasm. It
looks really shabby but it stands, even though two strong ropes seem to
drag it into the open mountain. Around the house is a little grassy
field stuffed in between the huge mountains. A small path trails of east
through the grass.

Exits.Description: A small path trails off towards the mountains.

Rooms.Name: A grassy field in the mountains
Rooms.Description:
You have reached a little field in the mountains, but it does not
look as harmonious as one could think or hope. The grass has some
greyish stuff on it that stains your feet when you touch it and on one
of the sides of the field a huge chasm opens up apparently tearing a
house apart.  A little path leads up into the mountains and west to the
house.

Exits.Description: A little house awaits your arrival to fall into the chasm.
A winding path takes you up, up and up.

Rooms.Name: On a mountain path
Rooms.Description:
The path whindles up and down, up and down, but it looks used. You see
the fine grain dust that covers the path. There have to be some places
that this path connects. Keep walking in either direction and you just
might get there. Below you a little field opens up on the mountainside
while the path continues north into a more mountainous terrain.

Exits.Description: A little path takes you through the mountains.
A small field in the mountains awaits your presence.

Rooms.Name: On a mountain path
Rooms.Description:
The path winds up and down, up and down, but it looks used. You see
the fine grain dust that covers the path. There have to be some places
that this path connects. Keep walking in either direction and you just
might get there. The path seems as endless as the mountainside you have
beside you. More mountainous terrain awaits you south and east.

Exits.Description: A little path takes you through the mountains.
A little path takes you through the mountains.

Rooms.Name: On a mountain path
Rooms.Description:
The path winds up and down, up and down, but it looks used. You see
the fine grain dust that cover the path. There have to be some places
that this path connects. Keep walking in either direction and you just
might get there. The path seems as endless as the mountainside you have
beside you. More mountainous terrain await you west and north.

Exits.Description: A little path takes you to the mountain.
A little path takes you through the mountains.

Rooms.Name: On a mountain path
Rooms.Description:
The whindling mountain path ends here or starts here depending on if
you came travelling down or from the south, shifting over into a set of
stairs. The stairs look really clean, either it is used a lot or
someone sacrifices a good deal of work and time to keep it clean.

Exits.Description: A little path takes you through the mountains.
A loooooooong stairwell.

Rooms.Name: A long stairwell in the mountains
Rooms.Description:
The steps are somewhat low to make climbing them easy. It is clearly
noticeably that you are in dwarven territory. The well tidied steps go
up and down from here. Below you the lower end of the stairs is visible.

Exits.Description: An even loooooooonger stairwell.
A loooooooong stairwell ends.

Rooms.Name: A long stairwell in the mountains
Rooms.Description:
The steps are somewhat low to make climbing them easy. It is clearly
noticeably that you are in dwarven territory. The well tidied steps go
up and down from here. Above you the upper end awaits your arrival.

Exits.Description: A loooooooong stairwell ends.
An even loooooooonger stairwell.

Rooms.Name: Top of some mountain stairs
Rooms.Description:
A fine little road surrounded by some bushes leads you between the top
of some stairs cut out directly from the mountain and something east of
here engulfed in some terrible greyish fog.

Exits.Description:
A big grey road goes towards the grey entrance of some huge grey
complex.
A loooooooong stairwell.

Rooms.Name: Following a road in the mountains
Rooms.Description:
The mountain road winds as it leads you through the mountainous
terrain. Make sure you do not slip a fall would be very disastrous. The
road goes north and west. Pick one or enjoy the view and the fresh air.

Exits.Description: You see little road trail off.
A little bushed road leads away.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Marvellous stone and sky make for a magnificent panorama for you to
enjoy.

Rooms.Name: Chute for walking guards
Rooms.Description: Takes them in to places between mill entrance and chasm 6554-6562

Rooms.Name: The Start of the Old Trail up the Mountains
Rooms.Description:
You are standing at the base of the Moria mountains. A half cleared
trail leads up the mountains to the north. To the south a trail leads
back to Midgaard. Far to the west you can see the river flowing into the
mountain and to the east you see the large forest of Namir. A large sign
has been placed on a pole here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The sign reads
North, Old Trail to the Dwarven mines.
South, Trail to the city of Midgaard.

Rooms.Name: Old Trail up the Mountain
Rooms.Description:
You are on a half cleared mountain trail. You are walking between
high cliffs and large rocks. The trail makes its way upward to the north
and to the south it goes down to the base of the mountain.

Rooms.Name: Old Trail up the Mountain
Rooms.Description:
You are walking on a old trail up the mountain. Large rocks and
cliffs surround you on both sides. The trail continues up to the north 
and down to the south.

Rooms.Name: Old Trail up the Mountain
Rooms.Description:
You have almost reached the top of the mountain. To the south you see
the forest of Namir. If you look very closely to the south-west you can
see the city of Midgaard. The trail continues up to the north and down
to the south.

Rooms.Name: Old Trail up the Mountain
Rooms.Description:
You are walking on a trail going up the mountain. Further ahead the
trail makes a turn around a large cliff. If you walk north you will go
around this rock and if you walk south you will go down the mountain to
its base.

Rooms.Name: The Hidden Room
Rooms.Description:
In a small, dark space lit only by a cheery magical fire, a troop of
gnomes swap tales in a storytelling contest.  The smokeless fire has
burned the same logs for many long years, and the outside world seems
far away.  There is a magical quality about this room, and it seems easy
to forget that there IS a world outside this one.

Exits.Description: The rough-hewn planks seem to fit together poorly.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Many years ago, the group left their yak farm on the plateau to help
their friends the dwarves.  Iron ore production was down, and the gnomes
relied on the fine plow-heads made by the dwarves, so there was a bit of
self-interest as well.  Once the gnomes had created and installed a
system of pulleys to help harvest the ore, they retreated to this small
cottage for a story-telling competition, the prize to be possession of
an enormous jar of cookies.  They have been here ever since.  No gnome
can resist the lure of a good story.

Rooms.Name: The plateau
Rooms.Description:
Here the narrow path leads to a plateau. On the plateau the path divides in
one branch going north up the mountain and one going east up the mountain.
To the south the path goes down to the valley.

Exits.Description: The path continues.
Mountain trail

Rooms.Name: Narrow path up the mountain
Rooms.Description:
You are on a narrow path leading up a ragged mountain. To the south the path
makes its way to a plateau.

Exits.Description: The path continues up the mountain.

Rooms.Name: Narrow path at the middle of the mountain
Rooms.Description:
Standing on the middle of the mountain, you can easily see the city of 
Midgaard far to the south, and the top of the mountain is very near to the
north.

Exits.Description: The top of the mountain is easily seen from here.

Rooms.Name: Top of Mountain
Rooms.Description:
You are now on the top of the mountain. To the south you see a path leading
down the mountain. To the east and west you see entrances to what seems like
mines.

Exits.Description: An entrance to the mountain which seems to lead underground.
There is an entrance to the mountain.

Rooms.Name: Narrow Path
Rooms.Description:
This is a narrow path leading to the Dwarven Kingdom. It looks less
traveled than the others, and it is very creepy. The path opens up to the
south, and continues to the north.

Rooms.Name: Entrance to Mountain
Rooms.Description:
Here is an entrance to the mountain. The door looks very well built, and you
can hear noise coming from within.

Rooms.Name: Bend in Narrow Path
Rooms.Description:
This is a narrow path that bends to the east here. The trees hang over the
path, and it is very overgrown. The narrow path continues to the south and to
the east.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: They hang over the road in the most ominous of ways.

Rooms.Name: Narrow path
Rooms.Description: This path is very narrow, and it continues to the north and west.

Rooms.Name: Narrow north-south path
Rooms.Description:
This path leads to the north and south. To the north you can see a door, and
to the south the path continues.

Rooms.Name: Door to Kingdom
Rooms.Description:
Here the path turns to the west. You can see a door in front of you, and the
path continues to the west and south.

Rooms.Name: Path to the Castle
Rooms.Description:
You are on a path that will eventually lead to the castle. It continues
north to the castle, and there is a door on the southern wall.

Rooms.Name: Still on the path to the Castle
Rooms.Description:
You are still on the path to the castle, or back to the Dwarven village,
whichever way you wish to go. The path continues to the north and south.

Rooms.Name: Door to Castle
Rooms.Description:
Here there is a door to the castle to the east. The castle is elegantly
designed, and looks much like a roll of toilet paper standing on it's end.
There is a sign which says: ****************************************** *
WELCOME TO THE CASTLE OF STRANGELOVE * * Here, celibacy is uninvited *
******************************************

Rooms.Name: Inside the entrance
Rooms.Description:
Everything here is covered in soot and very grimy. The path continues to the
east and north, and there is a door to the west.

Exits.Description: The little underground path continues to the north.
The path leads outside the entrance.
This looks like an entrance to some type of store room.

Rooms.Name: Path
Rooms.Description:
You are on a path in the dwarven village which leads north to the shops and
south to the corner of the area.

Rooms.Name: Turn in road
Rooms.Description:
You are on a path that leads to a Hide & Tooth shop to the west, and the
path continues to the south.

Exits.Description: The Hide & Tooth shop is seen to the west.

Rooms.Name: Hide & Tooth Shop
Rooms.Description:
You are in the Hide & Tooth shop. Here you may buy the finest in Dwarven
weapons and armors. The path continues to the north and east.

Rooms.Name: Path to the north of shop
Rooms.Description:
You are on a path to the north of the Hide & Tooth shop. The path continues
to the north, and there is Granite Head's bakery to the west.

Rooms.Name: North of Shops
Rooms.Description:
Here the path bends to the east towards the barracks. To the south you can
see the shops.

Rooms.Name: Path by Hospital
Rooms.Description:
Here the path passes by the Hospital to the north. It continues to the east
to the barracks, and to the west.

Rooms.Name: Path next to barracks
Rooms.Description: Here the path continues west, and east to the barracks.

Rooms.Name: Entrance to barracks
Rooms.Description:
Here there is an entrance to the barracks to the south, and the path
continues to the west.

Rooms.Name: Guard House
Rooms.Description:
You are in the guard house to the west of the entrance to the castle. There
are nudie posters covering the walls.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: There is a wall poster of a nude Minne Pearl.

Rooms.Name: First Barrack room
Rooms.Description:
Here is the first of two main rooms of barracks. The barracks continue to
the south, and you can leave the room to the north.

Rooms.Name: Back of Barracks
Rooms.Description:
Here is the back of the dwarven barracks. There are rows of beds here, and
there is a stench that is unbearable.

Rooms.Name: Inside of Castle Strangelove
Rooms.Description:
You are just inside the castle. It is very tubular in shape, and it is very
featureless. There is a set of stairs that lead up, and the door leads out of
the castle to the west.

Rooms.Name: A store room
Rooms.Description:
There is a layer of dust on the floor at least 3 inches thick! It is
probable that not many people have been in here for many months.

Exits.Description: A lighted area that looks like a well worn path.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: After blowing all the dust off the floor, you notice a trapdoor!

Rooms.Name: Wine cellar
Rooms.Description:
This room smells like wine, and you can only assume it used to be a wine
cellar at one time.

Rooms.Name: Stairs in castle
Rooms.Description: The stairs continue to circle up and down here.

Rooms.Name: Stairs
Rooms.Description:
You are still circling around on the stairs. You are starting to get dizzy
from going around and around and around and around and around. The stairs
continue up and down.

Rooms.Name: Top of stairs
Rooms.Description:
You are at the top of the stairs in the castle. There is an exit to the
east, and the stairs lead down.

Rooms.Name: Queen's waiting room
Rooms.Description:
This is the Queen's waiting room. Here the men literally "wait" for the
queen. You've heard that the queen really likes to get to 'know' her people, in
the biblical sense. The queen's bedroom is to the north, and you can see stairs
to the west.

Rooms.Name: Bedroom
Rooms.Description:
This is the Queen's bedroom. The bed is all ruffled, and there is a stack of
dirty sheets piled in the corner. There is a ladder that leads down, out of the
castle, and you can leave the room to the south. There is a sign that says:
------------------------- | I'm busy right now, | | and don't know when | | Ill
be back, but if | | there is a key here | | take it and PLEASE, | | try to get
my birth | | control pills back! | | I've heard they can | | be found
somewhere, | | deep in the mines.. | -------------------------

Rooms.Name: North side of Castle Strangelove
Rooms.Description:
You are standing on the north side of Castle Strangelove. You notice that
you are no longer inside the mountain anymore either. Along the southern
horizon you see towering mountains. THIS AREA IS NOT OPEN SO GO BACK UP!

Rooms.Name: Hospital
Rooms.Description:
You are inside the Dwarven Hospital. It smells like rubbing alcohol, and
there is blood all over the walls.

Rooms.Name: Granite Head's Bakery
Rooms.Description:
The aroma coming from this room is astonishing. You can almost taste the
pastry's dissolving in your mouth.

Rooms.Name: Dark path
Rooms.Description:
This path is very well worn, and there is an entrance to the mines to the
east, while the path continues to the north and west.

Rooms.Name: Mine entrance
Rooms.Description:
The little path here leads down toward the mines, while the worn path
continues to the west.

Rooms.Name: Bottom of mineshaft
Rooms.Description:
You are at the bottom of the mineshaft. The air here is very sooty, and it
is very hard to breath. The mineshaft leads up and east.

Rooms.Name: Path in the mine
Rooms.Description:
You are deep inside the mine, and you feel very uncomfortable. The path
continues to the east, and leads to the mineshaft to the west.

Rooms.Name: Mine crossroad
Rooms.Description:
You are at a crossroad in the mine. There is a door to the north, and the
path continues to the south, east, and west.

Rooms.Name: Coal Room
Rooms.Description:
You are inside the storage area for the raw materials that are found down
here. The room is very unsturdy as the supports are very rickety.

Rooms.Name: Mine Maze
Rooms.Description:
You have entered the maze of the mines. To the east you can see some
inscriptions, and you can exit to the south.

Rooms.Name: Maze inscription
Rooms.Description:
You are inside the maze, but not far enough in that you could get lost.
There is an inscription on the wall which says: 1 3 2 4 N W N S This isn't too
tough, so don't take it so rough.

Rooms.Name: Maze
Rooms.Description: You are in a maze.

Rooms.Name: Maze
Rooms.Description: You are in a maze.

Rooms.Name: Maze
Rooms.Description: You are in a maze.

Rooms.Name: Mining equipment room
Rooms.Description:
This is the storage room for equipment used by the Dwarven miners. It is
very small, and you can tell that not many miners actually use any equipment.

Rooms.Name: Solved the Maze
Rooms.Description:
You have solved the maze. You can tell by the last few moves that there is
no way that a dumb worker could have figured that out. It seems pretty desolate
here. To the south is a bleak room. To the north, you see the maze. There is a
sign above the south exit: THOSE WHO ENTER, PLAN ON A TIMELY DEATH. (ESPECIALLY
IF YOU'RE LOYAL TO THE QUEEN)

Rooms.Name: The Mazekeeper's Room
Rooms.Description:
You have entered the Mazekeeper's room. There are pictures of the Queen with
darts thrown in it. Spray painted on the wall are things like 'the queen shall
suffer' and 'Catholics Rule'.

Rooms.Name: The Start of the Old Trail up the Mountains
Rooms.Description:
You are standing at the base of the Moria mountains. A half cleared trail
leads up the mountains to the north. To the south a trail leads back to
Midgaard. Far to the west you can see the river flowing into the mountain and
to the east you see the large forest of Namir. A large sign have been placed
on a pole here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The sign reads
North, Old Trail to the Dwarven mines.
South, Trail to the city of Midgaard.

Rooms.Name: Old Trail up the Mountain
Rooms.Description:
You are on a half cleared mountain trail. You are walking between high 
cliffs and large rocks. The trail makes its way upward to the north and to the
south it goes down to the base of the mountain.

Rooms.Name: Old Trail up the Mountain
Rooms.Description:
You are walking on a old trail up the mountain. Large rocks and cliffs
surround you on both sides. The trail continues up to the north and down to
the south.

Rooms.Name: Old Trail up the Mountain
Rooms.Description:
You have almost reached the top of the mountain. To the south you see the
forest of Namir. If you look very closely to the south-west you can see the
city of Midgaard. The trail continues up to the north and down to the south.

Rooms.Name: Old Trail up the Mountain
Rooms.Description:
You are walking on a trail going up the mountain. Further ahead the trail
makes a turn around a large cliff. If you walk north you will go around this
rock and if you walk south you will go down the mountain to its base.

Mobs.Name: guard court George soldier
Mobs.LongDescription: George is a brave soldier in the service of King Welmar.
Mobs.Description:
All the nobles of the Court of Welmar travel with an escort, of course.
While he is a well-loved ruler, still every kingdom has its malcontents
and there are assassins known to be lurking along well-travelled routes.
The guards are chosen to match in height and build, and they are all
about 6' tall and quite muscular.  The ladies are all quite fond of
them, but they are only fond of each other.

Mobs.Name: guard court Paul
Mobs.LongDescription: Paul, a guard of the Court of Welmar, searches for danger.
Mobs.Description:
All the nobles of the Court of Welmar travel with an escort, of course.
While he is a well-loved ruler, still every kingdom has its malcontents
and there are assassins known to be lurking along well-travelled routes.
The guards are chosen to match in height and build, and they are all
about 6' tall and quite muscular.  The ladies are all quite fond of
them, but they are only fond of each other.

Mobs.Name: guard court John
Mobs.LongDescription: John wears the colors of the Court of Welmar.
Mobs.Description:
All the nobles of the Court of Welmar travel with an escort, of course.
While he is a well-loved ruler, still every kingdom has its malcontents
and there are assassins known to be lurking along well-travelled routes.
The guards are chosen to match in height and build, and they are all
about 6' tall and quite muscular.  The ladies are all quite fond of
them, but they are only fond of each other.

Mobs.Name: twins tina gina
Mobs.LongDescription: In the corner, Gina and Tina are making raspberry-blueberry ice cream.
Mobs.Description:
Gina and Tina are twins.  It is their job to turn cream from the
contented yaks into ice cream.  They add fresh raspberries and
blueberries - the ones that Razzl and Dazzl collect.  Yummmy!
Mobs.ActionScript:
%%8 em stick their fingers into the ice cream for a taste test.
;%5 say Do you want some ice cream? It'll be ready real soon!
;%8 say Have you met our cousin, the Brat Boy?
;%8 giggle

Mobs.Name: Gloria dwarf mother
Mobs.LongDescription: The anxious mother wonder if you have seen her brat son.
Mobs.Description:
As a dwarven mother with a daredevil son, Gloria is a constant nerve
wreck and with those kind of stunt her son pulls, one can not but agree
with her worries. Apart from that she looks like a nice woman with a well
cared for beard. A good sample of the mountains female dwarfs.
Mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 say Have you seen my son?
;%10 south
;%10 north
;%10 emote seems worried.
;%10 emote sighs slightly.
;%10 emote looks around looking for her son.

Mobs.Name: Brat dwarf boy daredevil
Mobs.LongDescription: Young and without fright a little boy dances around madly.
Mobs.Description:
The little boy dances around you like a wild. He even tries to climb
anything close to while doing so. He must be completely out of his mind
or just very persistent in NOT going to bed as his mother would suggest.
Not so strange when you are young and has a lot of extra energy.
Mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote does a little pirouette on the ropes.
;%10 south
;%10 north
;%10 west
;%10 east
;%10 emote sings out 'Nananananana Nananananana  Brat-Boy!'
;%10 emote jumps between the ropes.
;%10 emote teases you for being such a coward.

Mobs.Name: gnome ropeweaver shopkeeper fritz
Mobs.LongDescription: A little gnome dangles his legs over the edge of the chasm.
Mobs.Description:
The small gnome looks rather old, or old compared to other gnomes at
least, never seen a young gnome come to think about it. Maybe they are
born old. He holds a small pipe in one of his very callous hands. He must
have worked a lot with his hands to achieve that status. Maybe what is
inside his little house will explain how they became so used.
Mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote whistles innocently.
;%10 emote dangles his legs over the chasm edge.
;%10 emote wonders how his twin brother is doing.
;%10 emote takes a little puff on his pipe.
;%10 emote asks you 'Are you ready for a new experience?'

Mobs.Name: guard
Mobs.LongDescription: A big brute of a Mill guard is patrolling the premises and found YOU...
Mobs.Description:
If the ordinary dwarf is stocky compared with human standards he
still would look like a thin thread compared with this hunk of a dwarf.
Worth noticing is that he does not hold any rank implying that his
superiors would be worse. The guards are under strict orders to remove
(in any way possible) any trespassers and nothing will make these highly
trained guards disobey. Guess the punishment for disobedience is worse
than anything you can muster up.

Mobs.Name: guard
Mobs.LongDescription: A compact mill guard awaits YOU where he stands.
Mobs.Description:
If the ordinary dwarf is stocky compared with human standards he
still would look like a thin thread compared with this hunk of a dwarf.
Worth noticing is that he does not hold any rank implying that his

Mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 say Thank -YOU- for showing up - I waited here all day.
;%10 say Time for you to walk your final two yards. Down.
;%10 say Hello and very much Good bye!!!

Mobs.LongDescription: A compact mill guard awaits YOU where he stands.

Mobs.LongDescription: A compact mill guard awaits YOU where he stands.
Mobs.Description:
If the ordinary dwarf is stocky compared with human standards he
still would look like a thin thread compared with this hunk of a dwarf.
Worth noticing is that he does not hold any rank implying that his

Mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 say Thank -YOU- for showing up - I waited here all day.
;%10 say You know, you really are too good for this place.
;%10 say Hello and very much Good bye!!!

Mobs.Name: dwarf dwarven guard
Mobs.LongDescription: A dwarven guard is here.
Mobs.Description:
The guard looks very tough and mean. He wears his beard long, and he smells
like he hasn't bathed in over a month.

Mobs.Name: dwarf dwarven worker
Mobs.LongDescription: A dwarven mining worker is here.
Mobs.Description: He is very dirty, and looks extremely over-worked.

Mobs.Name: wraith
Mobs.LongDescription: A wraith is awaiting your first move here.
Mobs.Description: A black, almost transparent wraith.

Mobs.Name: storekeeper
Mobs.LongDescription: The Hide & Tooth storekeeper is standing here, waiting patiently.
Mobs.Description: The storekeeper is very rotund, but looks in excellent condition.

Mobs.Name: baker
Mobs.LongDescription: Granite Head, the baker, is waiting for a customer here.
Mobs.Description: Granite Head is covered with flour and grains.

Mobs.Name: lizard
Mobs.LongDescription: A giant lizard is foraging for food along the cavern floor here.
Mobs.Description:
This scaly creature looks like it is well adapted to it's underground
habitat.  He looks very powerful.

Mobs.Name: giant
Mobs.LongDescription: A giant is wandering around the mountainside here.
Mobs.Description:
The giant is about 18 feet tall, with arms of steel, and looks in
excellent physical condition.

Mobs.Name: dwarven dwarf miner mineworker worker
Mobs.LongDescription: A dwarven mineworker is here.
Mobs.Description: The mineworker is very tired, and very dirty, and he has bulging muscles.

Mobs.Name: dwarven mineleader dwarf mine leader
Mobs.LongDescription: A dwarven mine leader is here, supervising the work.
Mobs.Description:
The mine leader is very big and very strong, though he must be fairly bright
also, to have gotten this job.

Mobs.Name: dwarven healer
Mobs.LongDescription: The dwarven healer is here, aiding the sick of his people.
Mobs.Description: He is a very skilled healer, and extremely faithful to his god.

Mobs.Name: dwarven peon
Mobs.LongDescription: A dwarven peon is awaiting help here.

Mobs.Name: dwarf
Mobs.LongDescription: A dwarf is here.

Mobs.Name: barrack guard
Mobs.LongDescription: A barrack guard is here, lounging around while off duty.

Mobs.Name: mazekeeper
Mobs.LongDescription: A mazekeeper is here.
Mobs.Description: He looks VERY tough.

Mobs.Name: giant snake
Mobs.LongDescription: There is a giant snake here.

Objects.Name: key
Objects.ShortDescription: a key on a long golden chain
Objects.Description: A rusty iron key has been strung on a long golden chain.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This is the sort of key that looks like a small rusty flag.  It's pretty
clear the key hasn't been used in a long time, and probably was lost and
forgotten.

Objects.Name: large heavy key
Objects.Description: A large heavy key has been dropped.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This large, heavy metal key has been marked with the picture of
a gate.

Objects.Name: hammer dwarven
Objects.Description: Sometimes a dwarf's just gotta #WPOUND#G things, ya know?

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Crafted by the dwarven smiths, this hammer serves both as a tool
and a weapon. In times of war it can be used to pound away on enemies that
need pounding.  Either way, it is a trusty pounding item. It's not worth many
pounds, but it is dependable and trustworthy.  An insignia on its shaft reads
"MADE BY POUNDING PUN'S INC."

Objects.Name: plate dwarven mail
Objects.Description: Dwarves make all manner of armor.  This is dwarven plate mail.

Objects.Name: stick
Objects.Description: This long black stick is a branch off of a long black tree.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A magic stick off a magic tree, it is trying frantically to mend itself where
it was rudely ripped off by some passing giant.  It is not terribly good at
mending itself, though, and the healing vibrations seem to scatter everywhere
but on itself.  Perhaps if you hold it in your hand and wave it about a bit,
those around you might get better! Or ... not.

Objects.Name: stick
Objects.Description: A long, black stick was pulled from its tree long ago.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This stout stick looks easily combustible.  You could probably
use it as a torch if you lit the end of it.

Objects.Name: dwarven club
Objects.Description: A heavy, smooth, blunt piece of steel-sheathed wood is a dwarven club.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Now, a club sounds like a primitive weapon and, indeed it is, however the
dwarves managed to make this particular version of a club do a LOT of damage,
if you are strong enough to wield it.  Made of a solid hardwood at its core
then covered with a spiky layer of steel over that, this club was the dwarves
first defense against the giants ... before they learned to simply outsmart
them.

#CGiant stares at you, drooling.
You tell Giant, "Me no taste good.  You eat tree!"
Giant beams and wanders off, looking for a tree.#N

Objects.Name: two-handed dwarven axe
Objects.Description: A two-handed dwarven axe is here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
You can do a lot more damage if you swing at something with your
entire body weight behind the swing.  This axe is a perfect example of that
truism.

Objects.Name: helmet mininghelmet
Objects.Description: A sturdy, slightly dented helmet lies on the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
As every dwarf knows, "them rockies hurt!", especially when they hit you on
the head. To prevent this, every dwarven miner has to wear this helmet,
protecting them from the small pebbles that falls from the cavern roof. It
does not, however, protect them from the more heavy rocks. (or maces, clubs,
hammers and other tools of violence).

Objects.Name: gold dwarven wedding golden ring
Objects.Description: Gwandolyn must be washing dishes.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This golden ring represents very fine work of the dwarves.  On it you see
engraved the emblem of King Kwathoum, the current Dwarf King. Kwathoum gave it
to Gwandolyn when they married, long dwarfyears ago.

Objects.Name: gloves dwarven mining
Objects.Description: A pair of thick dwarven gloves are sturdy yet flexible.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
These gloves are made from yak hide tanned and beaten soft as a baby human's
skin.  They are tough enough to withstand the constant use by the miners, and
protect the dwarves' skin.

Objects.Name: gold lump nugget
Objects.Description: A very large nugget of gold sits on the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Perhaps if you took this to a metallurgist, he might tell you if it was
actually worth anything.  Or perhaps you could simply try to sell it.

Objects.Name: pick miningpick
Objects.Description: Hey ho, what do you know?  It sure looks like a mining pick!

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Heyho, heyho, we off to work we go... if you're gonna go mining, better have a
pick that can mine. And this one can. Thats why the dwarves use it, after all.
